In {{aniseries|PTS}}, she is a recurring character who first appeared in ''[[XY073|A Fashionable Battle!]]''. ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ===={{aniseries|XY}}==== Blossom is a {{tc|Furisode Girl}} loyal to [[Laverre City]] [[Gym Leader]] [[Valerie]]. She and another Furisode Girl, {{kal|Katherine}}, were first seen spying on {{an|Serena}} and {{an|Bonnie}} when they were looking through Valerie's fashion collection. They thought they would be perfect to participate in a fashion show of Valerie's collection and asked them to come with them. Blossom reappeared in ''[[XY074|Fairy-Type Trickery!]]'', where she was following {{Ash}} and Valerie's [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}}.
